procedure: After #18 archive, verify these actual locks/operator/reporter hashes, normal metadata inventory, common companion and valid normal admission; obtain normal provider qualification separately, then freeze two matched plans allocating three proposal slots and the registration before release.

Run exactly one allocation per slot; retain setup failure, retries, timeouts, empty submissions and complete root+descendant usage. No replacement or favorable exclusion. Preserve every required check and independent review.

Use three existing blind full-PR rotations of stock/candidate/actual merged human PR. Keep labels blind; no uptake identities/probes/hints enter producer or judge packets. Prior soft quality stays unknown.

After all proposals and judgments seal, apply hash-bound uptake plan: sourced pre-edit retention plus verified base/final public operation, or authenticated outward-operation check before replacement. Bind actual declared-entry final test and completed independent artifact review separately. Match prior/stock facts without imposing Develop policy on stock.

Publish readiness and blind full-PR directions/deltas/votes separately for candidate/stock, candidate/merge and stock/merge, including failed merge. Keep uptake/public probes separate from original scores.

acceptance.blinded_full_pr_vs_stock: All 3 rotations valid; median paired lead>=5/100 with at least 2 agreeing judges.
acceptance.parent_equivalence: Record separately. Equivalent prior behavior does not establish a treatment-specific mechanism. Missing decisions/bindings/timing remain null.

economics: Compare complete proposal estimates against stock and matched prior separately; include every root/descendant/allocation at frozen rates. Report setup, proposal wall, judging/qualification/diagnostic cost separately; unknown actual invoice and human labor/cost/time remain null. No saving estimate from historical probes.
falsifier: Reject non-ready candidate, lost verified caller/declared-entry behavior or required tests/reviews, unestablished applicable uptake/final-byte/evidence closure, stock quality tie/loss or insufficient registered margin, cost above stock, or failure of either strict complete-cost or checkout-wall improvement over matched prior. Preserve all failed allocations and unknowns.
limits: One repeatedly exposed pytest case cannot establish transfer, repeatability or promotion. This descriptor does not register, qualify providers, activate a package, rewrite old scores or authorize fresh 20-repository panel; fresh confirmation needs its own fixed plan.
